biomarkers.name: PTCH1 / SMO (Hedgehog pathway alterations)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Core driver pathway in BCC; vismodegib and sonidegib (SMO inhibitors) for locally advanced or metastatic BCC

biomarkers.name: TP53
biomarkers.clinical_use: Common UV-signature mutation characteristic of BCC

biomarkers.name: Gorlin syndrome (germline PTCH1)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Multiple BCCs at young age; odontogenic jaw cysts; palmar/plantar pits; medulloblastoma risk. Hedgehog-pathway targeting can reduce BCC burden in selected patients

biomarkers.name: PD-L1
biomarkers.clinical_use: Not a validated companion diagnostic in BCC; cemiplimab is approved for locally advanced or metastatic BCC previously treated with a Hedgehog pathway inhibitor or for whom a Hedgehog pathway inhibitor is not appropriate

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Nests of basaloid cells with peripheral palisading arising from basal layer of epidermis; clefting artefact between tumour and stroma
histomorphological_subtype.grading: No formal grading; growth pattern (superficial vs infiltrative) drives prognosis

tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Characteristic clefting artefact (tumour separates from stroma during processing); myxoid stroma

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Basal cells of interfollicular epidermis or hair follicle bulge stem cells
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Basaloid differentiation with characteristic peripheral palisading; expresses BerEP4, CD10, retains basal epidermal markers
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Hedgehog pathway activation (PTCH1 loss, SMO activating mutations) drives biology near-universally — pathway activation redirects basal cells toward BCC phenotype
